metadata.title: Key Management

props.name: capability
props.remarks: Business capability for securely managing cryptographic keys throughout their lifecycle to support data protection and system trust.

props.name: technology-domain
props.remarks: Key management systems, hardware security modules, software key vaults, and cryptographic lifecycle services.

props.name: architecture-pattern
props.remarks: Constraint pattern governing generation, storage, use, rotation, and retirement of cryptographic keys.

props.name: depends-on-pattern
props.remarks: Key management supports protection of data whose ownership and scope are defined by Data Core.

props.name: depends-on-pattern
props.remarks: Key management enables encryption operations defined by Data Encryption.

props.name: depends-on-pattern
props.remarks: Key management integrates with PKI for certificate-bound and asymmetric key usage.

props.name: nist-guidance
props.remarks: Key lifecycle management aligns with NIST SP 800-57 guidance.

props.name: nist-guidance
props.remarks: Key management supports cryptographic agility and algorithm transition as described in NIST SP 800-130.

props.name: nist-guidance
props.remarks: Key management aligns with NIST SP 800-53 controls governing cryptographic services and key handling.

metadata.remarks: Key Management defines enforceable requirements for the secure lifecycle handling of cryptographic keys. This pattern ensures keys are generated, protected, rotated, revoked, and destroyed in a manner that preserves the confidentiality and integrity of encrypted data while supporting cryptographic agility.

components.title: Key Generation and Registration
components.description: Ensures cryptographic keys are generated using approved mechanisms and registered for controlled use.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Exposure or compromise of cryptographic keys through insecure generation or handling.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Approved key generation and registration processes prevent weak or exposed keys.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Cryptographic keys are generated using approved algorithms and processes.

components.title: Key Storage and Protection
components.description: Protects cryptographic keys from unauthorized access, extraction, or misuse.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Extraction of cryptographic keys from local or memory-based storage.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Protected storage using HSMs or secure vaults prevents key compromise.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Cryptographic keys are stored and protected against unauthorized disclosure.

components.title: Key Use and Access Control
components.description: Restricts use of cryptographic keys to authorized processes, roles, and purposes.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Use of valid access to misuse cryptographic keys for unauthorized operations.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Access enforcement and usage controls restrict key operations.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Access enforcement governs cryptographic key usage.

components.title: Key Rotation and Revocation
components.description: Ensures cryptographic keys are rotated, revoked, or retired according to policy and risk posture.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Continued use of compromised or outdated cryptographic keys.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Lifecycle governance ensures timely key rotation and revocation.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Key management policies define rotation and revocation requirements.

components.title: Key Destruction and Retirement
components.description: Ensures cryptographic keys are securely destroyed when no longer required.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Improper destruction leading to key reuse or unauthorized recovery.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Verified destruction processes prevent residual key exposure.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Cryptographic keys are securely destroyed when no longer needed.
